name: @kasovy/neverapply-mcp
description: NeverApply MCP server is a tool that automates the process of filling out job applications on Lever, Greenhouse, and Ashby.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key. Required if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not provided.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Your Anthropic API key. Required if OPENAI_API_KEY is not provided.

PORT.description: The port to run the server on.

tools.name: apply_to_job_posting
tools.description: Apply to a job posting on Lever, Greenhouse, or Ashby.

url.description: The URL of the job posting.

npm.description: Run using npx (recommended). Environment variables must be set.

docker.description: Run using Docker. Requires environment variables to be set.

examples.title: Apply for a Software Engineer position
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the apply_to_job_posting tool to apply for a software engineer position at a company using the Greenhouse applicant tracking system.
examples.prompt: Please apply to this software engineer job for me: https://boards.greenhouse.io/openai/jobs/4017248007
